title: Apple Announces HomeView Smart Home Hub
excerpt: Apple has introduced the HomeView smart home hub, featuring a new version of Siri powered by Apple Intelligence.
body_html:
Apple has introduced a new device called HomeView as part of its recent push into the smart home market.

According to the announcement, the new smart home hub features the latest version of Siri and is powered by Apple Intelligence. The device is designed to be a part of the company's expanding smart home ecosystem.

No further details regarding the hardware specifications, pricing, or exact release dates were provided in the announcement.
